q: 销售额最高的三个商品类目是哪些?
detail: 前 3 名次序与真值一致
sql: SELECT p.category AS 商品类目, SUM(f.price) AS 销售额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item f JOIN ecom_dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 3

q: 帮我看看每个州的客户各贡献了多少销售额
sql: SELECT c.state AS 客户州, SUM(f.price) AS 销售额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item f JOIN ecom_dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 100

q: 一共有多少个不同的订单?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS 不同订单数 FROM ecom_fact_order_item LIMIT 10

q: 平均每个订单花了多少钱?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS 平均每单金额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item LIMIT 10

q: 运费总共收了多少?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight_value), 2) AS 运费总额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item LIMIT 10

q: 哪个类目的东西卖得最贵(平均单价最高)?
